definitions.success: translation_cm < 5 and rotation_deg < 5; proper symmetry minimum
definitions.supported: real confusion CI upper <0; synth confusion delta<0 and >=2 seeds improve; neither success CI upper<0
definitions.worsened: real or synth confusion CI lower>0 or success CI upper<0
definitions.S3: FEASIBILITY_ONLY; <=3 sessions uses frame bootstrap descriptive only
definitions.registered_comparisons: 3 rules x2 primary metrics; gated S4 additional exploratory comparison
definitions.depth_accuracy_gate: abs relative depth error median over non-final-test REAL231 <=0.05
definitions.depth_m_selection: SYNTH primary confusion seed mean minimum; smallest m on exact tie
definitions.unavailable: binary full-frame descriptive rates false; numerical pose errors available-only with counts

S1: VIS_RULE_V1 supported-visible >=6; both subset SQPnP/LM fits; subset+center RMSE; otherwise original S0 fallback
S2: full8 and each LOO7, two parities, minimum subset+center RMSE across18 final fits; fixed candidate enumeration tie

S3.eligibility: No fixed camera record; planner posthoc SD<=.05m and RMS<=2deg; no formula retuning
S3.offset_SD: sample SD of per-frame own downnormal dot bottomcenter, ddof1
S3.normal_RMS: RMS angle to normalized componentwise median normal, no sign flip
S3.calibration: other same-session reference frames only; own ID excluded
S3.uncertainty: <=3 sessions frame descriptive; >3 full319/13-session master draws subset eligible; always FEASIBILITY_ONLY
S3.SYNTH: own exact renderer floor plane ORACLE_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY

S4.ROI: front0123 centroid shrink0.85, positive finite depth median
S4.accuracy_gate: REAL231 primary per-frame mean THREE seed ABS(relative depth errors), then231 frame median<=.05; any missing primary seed FAIL
S4.grid: SYNTH primary confusion seedmean m1,2,3; smallestm exact tie; freeze before REAL
